mapper.select: SELECT i.task_id FROM management_task_item i WHERE i.target_type = 'COMIC' AND i.target_id = #{comicId} UNION SELECT i.task_id FROM management_task_item i INNER JOIN chapter c ON c.id = i.target_id WHERE i.target_type = 'CHAPTER' AND c.comic_id = #{comicId} UNION SELECT i.task_id FROM management_task_item i INNER JOIN page p ON p.id = i.target_id INNER JOIN chapter c ON c.id = p.chapter_id WHERE i.target_type = 'MEDIA' AND c.comic_id = #{comicId}
